description: This file defines the SecureFtpClient class which implements an FTP client interface with methods for connecting, copying files, listing directories, and configuring transfer modes.

classes.name: SecureFtpClient
classes.description: Implements FTP client operations with placeholders for actual implementation.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection to the specified host using provided credentials and settings.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Transfers a file to the FTP server given a path, filename, and input stream.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists directory contents at the specified path.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Configures whether data transfer should be in binary mode.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Configures whether to use passive mode for the FTP connection.
